record: runner protocol contract change (fix round 5, DD-A66, T3-34)
author: fix round 5 agent (claude-opus-5-5) under DD-A66
changes: HeartbeatControl.prune: list[str] | null -> list[PruneOrder] | null (1.0.0 cores always sent null; 1.0.0 runners ignore control.prune)
new model PruneOrder {request_id, checkpoint_id, run_id, relpath, sha256, bytes, policy, reason} (relpath run-relative, request_id/run_id one safe path component)

new route E11 POST /core/v1/runner/checkpoints/{checkpoint_id}/pruned: PruneReport -> 200 PruneAck | 404 PRUNE_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND | 409 PRUNE_REPORT_CONFLICT (+ 401/403 as every route); runner token, no job ticket

new models PrunedItem {relpath, bytes, sha256|null}, PruneReport {runner_id, request_id, run_id, relpath, sha256, bytes, already_absent, bytes_freed, removed[], detail, pruned_at} (validator: already_absent => removed empty and bytes_freed 0; otherwise removed lists the ordered payload and bytes_freed = sum), PruneAck {checkpoint_id, request_id, state: PRUNED, replayed}

D3 labels: module docstring and CheckpointReport.uri description now say that runner-local absolute paths reach the core (uri, free-form result outputs), are stored in the core DB owner-only and are never projected into public responses

public_contract.note: CheckpointView.state already admits PRUNED; CheckpointPrune projection keeps policy/reason/deleted[].bytes/bytes_freed/kept/candidate_status/note only

known_gap.issue: the generator declares a path parameter only for {job_id}; E11's {checkpoint_id} is a path template variable without a parameters entry in the generated document
known_gap.owner: scripts/dev/gen_runner_openapi.py (WP-2B tool, not owned by this fix)
known_gap.proposed_patch: cross_package/gen_runner_openapi.proposed.diff (every {name} of the path becomes a required string path parameter)
known_gap.validated: on a scratch copy: only the E11 path changes (parameters: checkpoint_id), every /jobs/{job_id}/* path is byte-identical

tests_pinning_the_old_contract.proposed_patch: cross_package/test_runner_protocol.proposed.diff (samples for the 4 new models, PruneOrder in the HeartbeatControl sample, version 1.1.0, 11 paths / E1..E11, one new consistency test)
